featuredArticle.excerpt: 2 Aethel, 1040 BF — estimated start; no clock hour. Bones escapes the locked cottage by emergency release, flees Fawful’s drone and ritual pursuit, reaches an unnamed goblin camp, and watches a dragon leave with an Archie-like figure. The camp-side fart-spray beat is kept without an assigned user or target; the one-hour map has no transcribed route. The ritual, identities, and final purse remain unresolved.

didYouKnow: ...that Bones leaves a guard’s shorts behind, escapes through a broken window, and spends one hour measuring a map whose route the filing refuses to invent?

...that Wario spent three hours hunting ten thousand missing gold in the Archive Hall, panicked at a joke about calling the Toad Police Force, and found Mr. T had already written 'AUDIT REQUIRED - WARIO' in the bottom-left corner months earlier?
...that the host on the Golden Land's road greeted a stranger by a name the stranger had not given, told him 'no benevolence', and later described himself as 'a memory'?
...that the Scorncrow told three separate filings it was not a monster, and when Remi Akamatsu finally tested the claim with a point-blank musket, the blood under the face was human?
...that Remi escaped two armed dungeon guards by drawing a goblin face on a cardboard box with a Sharpie marker and claiming to be a certified Box Guardian?
...that the Mount Ebott Survey Part VII file features Sans executing Flowey in a localized time-stop after recalling a midnight tea conversation with King Asgore?

editorialDirective.title: WAH! Editorial Directive — Time Filing Codes Are Now Mandatory:
editorialDirective.text: Eight filings say “30 Harvestide, 1040 BF” and not one of them says which came first. Waluigi is done guessing. Every new article now carries a filing code — TC:1040-08-30T23:50/SHD — year, month, day, the hour it happened, and which clock it happened on. The date you read stays in Waluigi's words. The code underneath it is checkable, and now something actually checks it. If you do not know the hour, you leave the hour off; you do NOT invent one. WAH!

spotlight.title: ⚖️ Pond Patrol Motions + Holy Midlands Diet
spotlight.subtitle: Post-Reclamation votes · Speaker Rivers observer memos
spotlight.excerpt: The reclaimed Vigilance has not settled the Toad crisis. The Pond Patrol is overextended, the hardliner deck faction has momentum, and the Diet is watching the ship through a new status review instead of stale Mandate-day calendar math.

campaignCovers.title: MARIO — The Locked Cottage, the Hypno-Helmet, and the Dragon at the Goblin Camp
campaignCovers.caption: Two armed Toad guards hold Bones inside the locked cottage; the emergency-release button is within reach, but the exit remains shut.

campaignCovers.title: SHADEWARD — The TOADALNAEC and the Three Lies
campaignCovers.caption: We are the toads. Remi takes a gold-turning toad by the hand while a crowd of ragged toads sings around them on the gangway of the old Vigilance, and the gloomy mask is held up at the edge of the frame.

campaignCovers.title: FEYWARD — The Soul-Ring, the Feywild Wildfire, and the Twenty-One Day Cut
campaignCovers.caption: Toad Lee awakens in full panic while Waluigi displays his unlocked cuffs, Quartermaster Cornburary inspects his ledger, and Hjumpik stands his ground before the burning doorway.

campaignCovers.title: MOUNT EBOTT — The Snowdin Bone-Line Registry
campaignCovers.caption: The signature. Sans at the table in a room he has not tidied, writing his name in plain letters at the foot of a document that keeps unrolling; Times New Roman standing over him with the clipboard, waiting.

campaignCovers.title: KIVOTOS — The Roll Call at Trinity
campaignCovers.caption: Classroom 2-B on the morning of the new advisor's first roll call: the sliding door, the window row, the contested front desk, and the back row that behaves like a separate country.

fieldGallery.caption: Haunting #3 crosses into solid force: Beta Luigi crushes a working Fire Flower flat beneath his boot on the wet Archive Hall stones.
The doorway, resolved: Hjumpik hauling Waluigi out by the sleeve while a second treant buds behind them.
After the compound rescue: Luigi's cap, clean bandages, and the note line that points toward the next arc.
The Scorncrow's mask knocked away — and a human face underneath it.
Inside the tree: the Skittering Grove, webbed boughs hung with wrapped shapes.
The grove at night: the Scorncrow's evil tree, bats at the roots, and Wario's stalled motorbike.
Eager's critical shortbow shot pins the Scorncrow at the feet.
A shambling mound eating the Overgrown Library, one volume at a time.
The red kitchen, where the cook's dinner makes the overgrowth wither.
Promo Mario's main stage — the clipping Waluigi is amending, loudly.
The Mario-shaped thing in the television, from the Revision 2 account.
Archie arrives on a thundercloud before the Tree of Woe.
The Dread Mansion corridor — the order nobody signed.
One object in an empty room: the axe, waiting, at the far end of the bridge.
Nine words, flatly placed: ‘Luigi... read it. Read the note. This changes everything.’
Empty blue overalls in the rubble — grinning with nobody inside.

historicalBackfills.label: Historical Backfill · Session I · 18 Harvestide, 1035 BF
historicalBackfills.title: The Bowser Jr. That Wasn’t — The Throne Room Was Infiltrated
historicalBackfills.summary: The fake Bowser Jr. session was used to enter Bowser’s throne room, move the garrison and routes, and place Fawthful’s operation inside the king’s command space before Cackletta’s first strike.
historicalBackfills.caption: First in the recovered sequence · inferred placement, exact hour unrecorded.

historicalBackfills.label: Historical Backfill · Session II · 18 Harvestide, 1035 BF · Throne Room Assault
historicalBackfills.title: The Assault on Bowser’s Throne Room — The Dragon at the Window
historicalBackfills.summary: The fake heir had already opened the throne room from inside when Fawthful’s dragon broke through its window and wall. Bowser ordered the garrison away from the dragon, preserved the survivors, and returned to confront the occupation.
historicalBackfills.caption: Second in the recovered sequence · throne-room breach and evacuation, not a present-day siege.

historicalBackfills.label: Historical Backfill · 2 Aethel, 1035 BF · The Debt Siege
historicalBackfills.title: The Debt Siege and the Sixty-Thirty Split — Wario's Claw and the Contract of Accord
historicalBackfills.summary: Two weeks after the Star Hill rescue, Wario brought a helicopter, a searchlight and a W-stamped mechanical claw to a billing dispute. Waluigi held his own study behind an ice wall, paid 150 gold down, and talked the siege into a signed 60/30 publishing accord — then the radio reported the clinic holding Luigi under lockdown.
historicalBackfills.caption: Mario's Disappearance Arc continues · a siege that ended in a signature, not a casualty list.

historicalBackfills.label: Historical Backfill · Efferd, 955 BF · Peach's Castle
historicalBackfills.title: The Unlocked Cell — A Ceremonial Guard Watches the Arrangement Shake Hands
historicalBackfills.summary: A month before Highsun 1. A Koopa in a cell that was never locked, Fawful's hand in his, three Mages' Guild hoods behind him. Bowser through the wall, the captain dead, one small orb, a hall cheering the Guild. The Chamberlain's dispatch order. Five hours of drains to a bean shop where the Guild had the witness's son and Fawful had a Guild cloak.
historicalBackfills.caption: Capital Intrigue File · the Arrangement, witnessed · one survivor, no escort.
